exam: 104年公務人員高等考試三級考試暨普通考試
subject: 英文

essays.text: Translate the following Chinese passage into English.（30 分）到底是什麼時候開始的，大家習慣以「年級」來粗分世代。真的是很粗糙的分法啊！像小學課堂上兩人共用的長桌，拿粉筆在中間畫一條線，看來是井水不犯河水，卻根本很輕易就能抹除。那樣的長桌不曉得現在還用嗎？問了小我四歲但同年級的朋友，說是沒用過。小我八歲但仍然同年級的朋友則是殘忍地回答：「那是什麼東西？」最後和我彼此複寫童年的，竟是大我五歲，被分到「六年級」去的友人，好感人地說：「有！『不要超線！』、『小氣鬼！』這樣。」

Translate the following English passage into Chinese.（30 分）The Bible is filled with reluctant leaders, people who did not choose power but werechosen for it. The Bible makes it clear that leadership is unpredictable： That the mostpowerful people often don’t get to choose what they themselves will do. Circumstancesthrust certain responsibilities upon them, and they have no choice but to take up theirassignment.The defining characteristic of a reluctant leader is that he is self-divided. He feelscompelled to do things he’d rather not do. This self-division can come in negative andpositive forms.The unsuccessful reluctant leader isn’t really motivated to perform the tasks assignedto him. The unsuccessful reluctant leader is passionless. His actions are half-hearted.
Write an English essay of no more than 350 words describing the experience of visiting anexhibition.（40 分）
